windows.notes: Fixed: chats breaking when both sides add each other at the same time. Added remove-contact, reveal-on-tap messages (shown as ciphertext by default), and burn-on-close chat history.

macos.notes: Fixed: chats breaking when both sides add each other at the same time. Added remove-contact, reveal-on-tap messages (shown as ciphertext by default), and burn-on-close chat history. Unsigned build — right-click the app and choose Open the first time to get past Gatekeeper.

linux.notes: Fixed: chats breaking when both sides add each other at the same time. Added remove-contact, reveal-on-tap messages (shown as ciphertext by default), and burn-on-close chat history. Extract the tarball and run the client_app executable inside bundle/.
